moments.text: Cropped upright phone video at dusk: a bright white light hangs before a dark tree line, above the pale pond, brush in the foreground.
Directly below it, a second, fainter point at the water line stretches into a short vertical streak, shrinks to a dot, and fades by 0:04.6.
The light dims to a faint grey smudge for about a second, then comes back; it dims again at 0:38.5-0:40.
The camera tilts up, showing pale sky and a distant ridge at the top; the light sits lower, then drifts to the right edge.
The camera swings off the light for about two seconds; it streaks back in from the top and settles near the centre.
The whole picture darkens sharply for about ten seconds; the light stays bright near the centre.
The light swells into a larger, softer pale disc for about three seconds, then shrinks back to a sharp point.
It swells again into a large, very bright disc for about eight seconds, with a brief dip at 2:47, before tightening.
The light turns dim and soft: a pale, out-of-focus disc that flickers and briefly sharpens for about ten seconds.
The light blurs into a pale ring with a darker centre, then snaps back to a bright point.
The light rises toward the top of the frame as the camera moves, and the clip ends.

notes: Footage is a privacy crop: a 606 px wide upright strip with black side bars (stored crop 606:1080:656:0).
